push.title: L 0-5 vs SydSwny FanClub | You: 5.9 (worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 5.9. Go easy on yourself tonight; tomorrow we roll up our sleeves.

DID WELL
+ Logged 18 minutes like a pro.

WORK ON
- Only 0 passes (down from your usual 18). Little adjustment: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
- No tackles attempted. Simple fix: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. That's a promise.
- Rating came in 0.9 below what your on-ball stats earned. Lesson of the day: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked. Simple as Sunday.
- Funny thing: buddskees wrestled with on-ball involvement too. Two heads, one fix: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- 1.8 off your norm. Let it go like a bad haircut. It'll grow back.

Try this in practice: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.

Remember, BellyTb1: There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

Rome wasn't built in a day; neither is a great player. - Coach Lasso
